title: Do LLMs Know a Good Hypothesis When They See One? Logit-Based Energy Scoring Outperforms Prompted LLM-as-Judge for Scientific Hypothesis Ranking
abstract: arXiv:2608.17270v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for scientific hypothesis generation. However, evaluating generated hypotheses remains a challenge for trustworthy AI-enabled scientific workflows. Existing approaches often use LLMs as judges or rely on semantic similarity, which can favor familiar ideas over novel ones. We propose a logit-based energy scoring method that evaluates hypotheses using a language model's intrinsic confidence rather than comparative judgment. We benchmarked seven language models on 1,323 papers across 12 disciplines. Each paper was paired with its hypothesis and fifteen incorrect alternatives. Intrinsic scoring reached 33.0% Hit@1 pooled across both scorers, compared with 16.6% for prompted listwise ranking. The strongest configuration, a 1-billion-parameter model using logit-based energy scoring, reached 53.1%, though this was the maximum across 14 model-by-scorer combinations selected post hoc. translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于科学假设生成。然而，评估生成的假设对于可信赖的人工智能驱动的科学工作流仍然是一个挑战。现有方法通常使用LLMs作为裁判或依赖语义相似性，这可能会偏向于熟悉的想法而非新颖的想法。我们提出了一种基于对数的能量评分方法，该方法利用语言模型的内在置信度而非比较判断来评估假设。我们在12个学科的1,323篇论文上对七个语言模型进行了基准测试。每篇论文都配有其假设和十五个错误替代方案。内在评分在两种评分器池化后达到33.0%的Hit@1，而提示式列表排序仅为16.6%。最强配置是使用基于对数能量评分的10亿参数模型，达到53.1%，尽管这是事后选择的14种模型-评分器组合中的最大值。总体而言，在...
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于对数能量的评分方法，利用语言模型的内在置信度来评估科学假设，在排序任务中显著优于传统的提示式LLM裁判方法，尤其适用于提升科学发现中的新颖性判断。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a logit-based energy scoring method that leverages a language model's intrinsic confidence to evaluate scientific hypotheses, significantly outperforming prompted LLM-as-judge ranking, especially for enhancing novelty assessment in scientific discovery.
